title: Kalshi Head of Research on Midterms Accuracy
title_cn: Kalshi Head of Research on Midterms Accuracy
summary: Nicole Kagan, Head of Research at Kalshi, joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the prediction platform's accuracy on 2026 midterm election night, saying that bets on the platform were over 98% accurate across Tuesday's races. She points out that traders rapidly repriced races like the South Carolina senate race within minutes of polls closing, and often before news outlets called results. Kagan also discusses how her team digests the outcomes of trades on major events, and how participants gather information to support their bets. She also discusses how institutional investors might apply the platform's probability and price discovery component in their daily work. Kagan speaks with Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Scudder Says Texas Is Not for Sale
title_cn: Scudder Says Texas Is Not for Sale
summary: Kendall Scudder, Texas Democratic Party Chair, says Democrats' statewide wins in Texas were the result of people working hard over multiple election cycles and rebuilding the party's infrastructure. Scudder says Texas is open for business, but communities should have a say in data center development instead of finding out after decisions have already been made. Scudder believes Democrats' priorities should include corruption reform, reducing property taxes and rolling back school vouchers while strengthening public schools. He speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s Special Edition of "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Panetta Says Voters Sent Trump a Message on Iran War

Panetta says Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has little credibility with either Democrats or Republicans on Capitol Hill, has failed to keep Congress adequately informed and says Trump will eventually have to decide whether to keep him in the job. Panetta says Trump has to recognize that the American people have spoken clearly and do not support the war with Iran. He speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s Special Edition of "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Businessweek Daily: Dems Stage Midterm Sweep (Podcast)
title_cn: Businessweek Daily: Dems Stage Midterm Sweep (Podcast)
summary:
The people, companies and trends shaping the global economy. Watch Carol and Tim LIVE every day on YouTube: http://bit.ly/3vTiACF

Riding a tide of voter angst, Democrats swept into power in Congress, with outrage over the cost of living and the war in Iran leading to a thundering rebuke of President Donald Trump and his party just two years after his dominant White House comeback. In a seismic political shift, Democrats’ strength suggested a breakdown of the coalition that delivered Trump a second term. The election results threaten to slow the pace of the AI infrastructure buildout, with policymakers potentially turning up the heat on increasingly unpopular data center projects.

On today's episode:

Joe Mathieu, Bloomberg 'Balance of Power' Co-Host
Brody Ford, Bloomberg News Tech Reporter
Nathan Dean, Bloomberg Intelligence Senior US Policy Analyst
Joe Lovinger, Bloomberg News Texas Reporter (Source: Bloomberg)
